title: Prove Browser App Live Backend Smoke
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repositories, Checklist target, and Evidence target before editing Editor.
The smoke requires Project Control to implement product behavior.
The smoke requires Editor production code to import Core internals outside the Core adapter boundary.
The smoke bypasses the Backend HTTP/revision gate or replaces the live Backend server with mocked fetch evidence.
The smoke makes browser-app or production-readiness claims broader than the bounded local loopback evidence can support.
verificationTarget: An Editor-owned browser test starts a live Backend server, launches the rendered Editor app with the live Backend URL, exercises a visible browser path for capability/read/migration/mutation or records the exact missing UI blocker, and Project Control records the result without broad map promotion.
summary: Done: the Editor-owned browser smoke now proves the bounded product-route live Backend path from the rendered app through library read, capability/read, migration, and one UI mutation, with Project Control evidence registered without broad truth promotion.
